title: The Teardown 002 — five repos promise to cut your token bill
description: Five repos claim to cut Claude Code's token usage by 40% to 98.9%. All five publish a number. Only one measured it on a task set it did not write, with a quality control alongside the saving. What the evidence actually says, what the tool actually does, what it actually costs, and whether it earns a slot.
